attackers_goals: The attacker attempts to gain access to the account.
description: A local user account failed to log in multiple times in a short time period. This may indicate a brute-force attack.
investigative_actions: Verify any successful authentication by the user account referenced by the alert, as these can indicate the attacker managed to guess the credentials.
